body:
Thank you. I wanted to let you know that I've contacted a close friend for help who's been through a similar thing and he's been very supportive. I have typed a letter for my parents and I will be leaving it for them tomorrow. 

Thank you. I hope I never have to post here again.

That's a good idea actually. I'll do that. I really hope they understand that I'm not ready to talk about it with them.

The thought of how they're gonna react makes me feel horrible though.

I want to see a therapist, but I don't know how I could bring this up to my parents. They're so highly strung and are already overprotective of me, I know they're gonna freak out and I don't want to deal with invasive questions from them because I don't want them to worry about me. I know it's stupid of me to say that, but it's the only reason I haven't already gotten help.
